takeaway: The intrinsic pathway runs XII, XI, IX with VIII and calcium. Factor VII is not part of it; it belongs to the extrinsic pathway.

question.text: All of the following are involved in the intrinsic pathway of clotting except which?

lines.text: The intrinsic pathway starts when blood meets collagen under the endothelium.
Active factor twelve activates factor eleven, and active eleven activates factor nine.
Factor nine then forms a complex with active factor eight.
But factor seven? It is the one standing apart: not intrinsic.
So the exception is factor seven.
